A LITTLE ABOUT ME

01 / 10

Aishvary Turkar

I’m a Mechatronics M.Sc. student at the University of Siegen, bringing more than two years of manufacturing engineering experience. I’m interested in connecting manufacturing with robotics and automation.

I have worked on CNC machine commissioning, production process validation, automation initiatives, and shop-floor improvements. Outside of work, I keep exploring robotics, embedded systems, and hands-on projects.

My goal is to bring practical engineering and thoughtful problem-solving together to make systems work better.
